identity.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON; lexical collection and document-ID order; recursively lexical map-key order; preserve array order; include full decoded semantic metadata and document identity; exclude self catalogueFingerprint and local synchronization bookkeeping.
identity.legacyChangeHash: CatalogueContract.fingerprint remains the existing FNV content-change hash and is not an archive identity.

archive.sourcePolicy: Only non-deleted SYSTEM source rows are archived, preserving payload JSON and source document/payload identities independently.
archive.collisionPolicy: Identical archive key and canonical payload is an idempotent no-op; same key with different content throws and aborts the enclosing transaction.
archive.transactionPolicy: Archive the current SYSTEM preimage before reconciliation and write the incoming installed release marker last, in the same SQLite transaction as snapshot reconciliation.

installation.sameVersionSameContentWithoutToken: Compute the exact current installed snapshot SHA-256 and upgrade only the release marker.
installation.olderMarkerWithoutToken: Derive a deterministic identity from exact currently installed SYSTEM metadata before archival; do not assign it to Product or Variant records.

productProvenance.createRule: New Products require exactly one valid installed SYSTEM fingerprint for Release 4 (data version 4, CatalogueContract schema revision, and compiler revision). The value is written into Product fields in the existing atomic create operation; Variants inherit through productId.
productProvenance.editRule: Ordinary edit and reclassification preserve saved provenance; only a separate approved semantic migration may retag.
productProvenance.duplicateRule: A duplicate receives the currently installed canonical Release 4 fingerprint as a new Product.
productProvenance.nullRule: Absent, null, or malformed provenance never triggers current-catalogue/name/date/ID semantic fallback.

resolution.historicalLookup: Exact archive namespace selected by Product catalogueFingerprint; Variant resolution follows exact productId to its Product. No current selector tables, names, timestamps, or semantic similarity are consulted.
resolution.provenanceMissingBehavior: Keep raw saved Product fields available and expose explicit provenanceMissing status for manual review.
resolution.ceiling: Same document ID under different fingerprints preserves distinct historical payloadId and current canonical identity.
resolution.basement: Historical Basement identity remains absent from Release 4 Liquid/Cementitious keys; no mapping or retagging is performed.

validation.analyzer: 48 pre-existing info/warning diagnostics; no errors in changed implementation or archive tests.
